data._document_notes: The PDS groups multiple plans. Essentials, Medical Only and Cancellation Only are international single-trip only. International Comprehensive and Domestic have both Single Trip and Annual Multi-Trip variants. Non-Medical is presented as a separate international plan with cruise non-medical benefits included and explicit exclusions for any medical-related claims and cancellation due to the traveller’s illness/injury. Cruise Cover add-on is available and required for multi-night ocean/sea cruises on Comprehensive, Essentials, Medical Only and Inbound; it is not available on Cancellation Only; Non‑Medical includes non‑medical cruise benefits without add-on. COVID‑19-related claims are excluded across plans. Exact maximum journey duration options for Annual Multi-Trip are not printed in the PDS; set as unknown.
